From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: [Draft] Growth pillar realign — leadership comms & QBR prep

Team,

Quick summary: as part of our Q3 focus I’m proposing we consolidate two GTM pillars (Growth & Expansion) into a single “Growth” pillar with three substreams (Demand Gen, Product-Led Expansion, Partnerships). The change simplifies OKR alignment and reduces duplication of headcount across manager orgs.

Why now: our QBR cadence showed repeated overlap in objectives and double-work between pillar leads — consolidating will: 
- reduce cross-team dependencies (fewer weekly syncs)
- sharpen ownership for net-new revenue vs expansion
- simplify the QBR narrative for execs and ACME pilot conversations

What I’m proposing now:
1) Leadership announcement (internal) that outlines the new pillar, owners, immediate role transitions, and a short FAQ.
2) Manager-1:1 talking points and a drop-in Q&A session for impacted ICs.
3) Updated org chart + a QBR slide update to reflect the change.

Attached: org-chart-v3.pdf (proposed reporting lines), qbr-slide-deck-v1.pptx (slide with rationale + metrics).

Asks: please review the announcement draft and org chart by EOD Wednesday (May 19). Laura — can you check the manager transition wording? Vivek — can you confirm the metrics slice we should call out on the QBR slide (ARR growth vs expansion revenue)? Monica — can your comms team take the FAQ and produce the short email draft for managers?

Timing: I’m targeting a send/window of May 25–26 so we have time to surface legal/hr concerns and update the QBR deck for the May 28 leadership review.

Thanks — Adi

--
Aditya Rao
Head of GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Adi — thanks for drafting this. A few quick notes:

- Manager transitions: please be explicit about which managers are changing spans vs roles. Folks will ask whether there are promotions or lateral moves. I recommend a short table in the FAQ (role / old manager / new manager / effective date).
- Timing: May 25 is fine, but HR needs a 72-hour heads-up for individual notices. Can we plan an internal pre-brief for the managers on May 24?
- Metrics: don’t call out ARR growth targets in the public announcement — keep it directional ("improve net-new pipeline efficiency") and reserve numbers for the QBR slide.

I’ve made inline comments on the org-chart-v3.pdf (see page notes) and dropped a suggested manager-notice template in the drive link.

— Laura
SVP, People Operations
